title: Marie L NDE 8155
content: The experience happened during the birth of my second daughter. Everything was going normally until the nurse injected something into my IV. Immediately I heard the loud alert on the heart monitor go off. I suddenly saw everything become a light grey color. I felt as if I was not only lying down, but had the sensation that I was being pulled in a backwards motion. I didn't see anyone in particular. But the feeling that I had was of absolute peace. This lasted for some minutes, but I wouldn't be able to say how many minutes. From seemingly nothing, I felt pulled backwards. As I opened my eyes, I noticed all of the nurses were super-attentive. They were looking at me as if something had almost happened. My daughter was born safely and perfectly. I never had this type of experience again.
